Omnichannel is more than connected channels.

For a full sense brand, the challenge is to translate one recognisable brand experience across different moments, senses and contexts.

Rituals as a full sense brand

The experience has layers.

A Rituals experience can be visual, tactile, fragrant, audible and emotional. Different channels can carry different parts of that experience while still feeling unmistakably connected.

Smell and touch are immediate in the boutique. Fragrance can be discovered in the moment. Digital can support that experience through language, imagery, familiarity, recommendations and context.
People · Data · CRM · Platforms · Architecture · Operations

Each touchpoint has a role.

Boutiques create sensory immediacy and human interaction. Digital adds context, convenience and personalisation. My Rituals and Customer Relations can extend recognition and continuity beyond a single purchase.

The value is in the connection.

Customer data, CRM, platforms, architecture, people and operations help those moments feel connected rather than fragmented.

Different channels. Different strengths. One recognisable brand experience.

Why this resonates with how I think

I learned early that people are more than the format or channel they use. Their needs change with the moment. What fascinates me about Rituals is that omnichannel goes one step further: the experience itself has to translate across physical and digital worlds.

A customer is more than a channel. And a brand experience is more than a touchpoint.
How I would enter the portfolio

Make the most important signals visible in one shared view.

I would want to understand where customer signals, brand experience, business value, dependencies and capacity intersect. The goal is not to arrive with a fixed diagnosis, but to help teams see the current picture clearly and focus where experience, value and feasibility come together.

Why this next step

I want to bring my digital ecosystem experience into an environment where physical and digital experiences strengthen each other.
